This powerful presence approaching the barrier... Even stronger than %s's...
I expected you to amuse yourself with the barrier for a while, but apparently not today. You...
strings.그냥 이야기가 하고 싶어서 왔어. 여길 들어온 건 정말 오랜만이네. 여기: I just wanted to talk. It's been so long since I came inside. Did this place always look like this...? My memory's fuzzy♡
You're smiling, but you look dreadful. You seem to need some comfort.
strings.초인이라 불리지만, 고통과 슬픔 앞에서는 신도 어쩌지 못하는 나약한 인간: We may be called Champions, but in the face of pain and grief, we are merely frail humans whom even the gods cannot help...
I was thinking while I made Edda's gravestone... I just couldn't bear it.
Melvic understands me well, but I couldn't tell him everything in my heart...
I thought I'd put it all behind me...
So I was the person you wanted to talk to.
strings.사실 가까운 곳에 중년 아저씨랑 도마뱀 영감이 있긴 하지만, 왠지 싫더라: Well, there's a middle-aged man and an old lizard nearby, but I didn't feel like talking to them.
How rude of you to speak that way about such distinguished people...
strings.후우, 그래요. 말씀하세요. 듣는 것뿐이라면 들어드리겠습니다. 시간은 충: Sigh. Very well. Speak. If all you need is someone to listen, I will. We have plenty of time.
strings.시간? 나는 몰라도 메디아는 마냥 길지만은 않을 것 같은데?: Time? Maybe I do, but yours doesn't seem endless, Medea.
It's all right... As long as I don't choose to prepare for my departure...
I always think this, Medea: you're a child, but
you talk like an old woman.
It's all right. I'm still younger than you.
strings.뭐야, 메디아? 어리고, 키 크면 다야?: What's that supposed to mean, Medea? Think you're special just because you're younger and taller?
That was not what I meant...
strings.후우, 당신을 마을에 들이는 게 아니었습니다…. 또 마을 사람들이 잔뜩: Sigh. I shouldn't have let you into the village... You've frightened the villagers again.
strings.저기 저쪽에 있는 아기 양은 손에 펜과 종이를 들고 눈동자를 반짝이고 있: That little lamb over there has a pen and paper ready, and her eyes are sparkling♡
Sigh... I'll listen to you, so please give Merimel your autograph.
strings.(샤이닉이 한참 동안 메디아에게 에다와 함께 했던 과거의 기억과 현재의: (Shynic spends a long time telling Medea about her memories with Edda and the tangled emotions she feels now.)
strings.(잔뜩 이야기하고 기분이 풀렸는지, 살짝 어두워 보였던 샤이닉의 얼굴이: (Talking seems to ease her heart. The shadow over Shynic's face lifts, and she looks more at peace.)
I'm glad it helped. I hope that was all you needed. Please go home now.
strings.샤이닉, 당신에게만 반응하는 결계를 더욱 강하게 만들거니 그리 알아두세요: Shynic, I intend to strengthen the barrier that reacts specifically to you. Consider yourself warned.
strings.내가 뚫고 들어올 수도 있는데 안 그러는 거 알고 있지?: You do realize I could break through it if I wanted, don't you?
strings.문득 당신 생각을 듣고 싶군요. 모든 초인이 그에게 힘을 나눠주는데, 전: I suddenly find myself wanting your opinion. All the other Champions have shared their power with the adventurer, but I haven't yet. What do you think?
It's your choice, Medea. Do what you want.
My choice, for which the time has not yet come... Yes, I understand.
strings.(메디아의 입가에 살짝 미소가 퍼진다. 샤이닉도 그 미소의 의미를 알아차: (A faint smile touches Medea's lips. Shynic seems to understand its meaning.)
strings.그럼 나는 갈게…, 다음에 또 올테니 잘 있어♡ 죽지 마, 알았지? 쿨럭: I'll be off, then... I'll come again, so take care♡ Don't die, all right? Cough, cough...
strings.자, 잠깐만요? 다음에 또 온다는 건…?!: W-wait! What do you mean, you'll come again...?!
